svg.title: FridgeGraph: a schedule change through the village, Rosina, Apollo Federation and the saved result
svg.desc: People contribute information. Rosina is the co-pilot. Muse Spark supports grounded reasoning; exact calendar commands have a deterministic parser. Apollo MCP tools or direct GraphQL reach the Router's federated supergraph and seven subgraphs. The parent reviews and confirms. An authorized calendar mutation saves the event, write receipt and Activity event together. Permitted views read the saved result. This is an illustrated architecture flow, not a live call recording.
svg.text: A schedule changes. The village stays connected.
Illustrated example: Nora’s violin rehearsal moves from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
PEOPLE SUPPLY THE SIGNALS · THE GRAPH REPRESENTS THEIR RELATIONSHIPS AND RIGHTS
Understands the request · gathers permitted facts · explains the option
Plans each request across the domains it needs; carries the caller’s identity.
Shared entity keys connect the child and village across domains. Each resolver enforces access.
SUPABASE POSTGRES · domain tables + row-level permissions
Reads and proposals do not save changes
Existing event resolved · date and Detroit time checked · parent reviews the exact change
AUTHORIZED WRITE · SAME GRAPH, EXPLICIT MUTATION
Apollo Router → Schedule resolver → Supabase transaction
Permission rechecked · retry key checked · event + write receipt + village activity saved together
The stored event now says 5:00 PM
Who changed it, what changed, when
Read the same saved event on refresh
Rosina can say “It’s recorded” only after the backend confirms the save.
Muse Voice Transcribe · original speech path
Illustration of system responsibilities · not live telemetry · authorized views, not automatic external-calendar sync
Documented connected-router setup; local Rover composition also supported. Not a per-person database.
THE COMMUNICATION BRANCH · PEOPLE RESPOND THROUGH CONNECTED CHANNELS
Separate authorized outreach flow; saving a calendar event does not automatically call or text anyone.
New SMS transport calls GHL directly
Working SMS and call integrations, confirmed by Bryan.
Live outreach is deliberately suppressed in testing to protect integrated real contacts.
Owner-reported operational status · no new provider test represented by this illustration
